findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink

Untrusted content: prepare_french_einvoicing_recipient, get_uk_beneficial_owners, get_danish_company_filing, get_belgian_insider_transactions · Private data: get_french_sector_benchmarks, get_french_company_capital, get_uk_company_insolvency, list_finnish_company_filings, get_danish_company_filing, get_latvian_company_insolvency, get_french_company_pdf_report, list_french_company_documents, download_french_company_document, get_french_company_kyb_file, get_french_company_kyb_batch, prepare_european_invoice_file, prepare_french_invoice_file, verify_iban_bank, create_surveillance_watch, get_surveillance_watch · Public sink: prepare_french_einvoicing_recipient, get_french_company_capital, detect_company_identifiers, create_surveillance_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_french_einvoicing_recipient, get_uk_beneficial_owners, get_danish_company_filing, get_belgian_insider_transactions · Private data: get_french_sector_benchmarks, get_french_company_capital, get_uk_company_insolvency, list_finnish_company_filings, get_danish_company_filing, get_latvian_company_insolvency, get_french_company_pdf_report, list_french_company_documents, download_french_company_document, get_french_company_kyb_file, get_french_company_kyb_batch, prepare_european_invoice_file, prepare_french_invoice_file, verify_iban_bank, create_surveillance_watch, get_surveillance_watch · Public sink: prepare_french_einvoicing_recipient, get_french_company_capital, detect_company_identifiers, create_surveillance_watch
